sections.text:
In a beautiful forest with a wide and deep river running through it, there was a smart and kind monkey who lived on a huge and fruitful “pink apple” tree located right on the river bank.

The monkey spent his days eating delicious and sweet apples and swinging between the branches happily and calmly, and he had a kind heart and loved helping others.

One day, a huge, slow crocodile came to swim in the river near the tree, looking tired and hungry after a failed hunting trip.

The good monkey saw him, felt pity for him, picked a ripe, sweet pink apple for him and threw it into the river, saying: “Come in, my crocodile friend, you look hungry. Taste these delicious apples!”

The crocodile ate the apple, and it was the best thing he had ever tasted in his life, so he thanked the monkey very much for his generosity and kindness.

Since that day, the crocodile visited the monkey daily, and they became very close friends, spending long hours talking and chatting. The monkey would throw fresh apples to the crocodile to eat and take some to his wife, who was waiting for him at home on the other side.

When the crocodile's wife (the cunning crocodile) ate the apple, she liked its very delicious sugary taste, but she thought with a malicious and evil thought!
Smiling mischievously, she said to her husband: “If these apples are so sweet and delicious, imagine how delicious and sweet the monkey heart that eats them every day will taste! Please, I am suffering from illness and there is no cure for me except for you to bring me this monkey heart so I can eat it!”

The crocodile was shocked and strongly refused, saying: “This is impossible! He is my loyal and generous friend who feeds me every day. I cannot kill him and betray him!”

But the cunning crocodile began to cry and pretend to be sick and in severe pain, and said that she would die if he did not bring her his heart.

The kind and foolish crocodile gave in to his wife's request under the pressure of crying, and decided to betray his monkey friend with great regret.

The next day, the crocodile went to the tree and said to the monkey with a devious smile: “My dear friend, my wife is very fond of apples, and she invites you to have lunch at our house on the other side to thank you herself. Will you accept our invitation?”

The monkey was happy with the invitation and said: “Of course I accept! But I am a monkey and I cannot swim to reach your house.”

The crocodile quickly replied: “Don’t worry, ride on my broad back and I will carry you safely across the wide river.”

The monkey confidently jumped onto the back of his friend the crocodile, and they began their journey into the deep waters.

When they were in the middle of the deep river, where the monkey could not escape or swim, the crocodile felt extremely guilty and wanted to be frank with his friend before killing him.

The crocodile said sadly: “Forgive me, my monkey friend, I lied to you.

My wife is not sick, she asked me to bring her your sweet heart to eat because you eat apples! And now I will dive with you until you drown and take your heart!”

The monkey suffered a violent shock and extreme horror when he discovered his friend's betrayal and his inevitable end in this deep river, but his innate intelligence saved him at the last moment.

The monkey remained calm and did not show his fear, and said quickly and confidently: “Oh my God! Why didn’t you tell me that while we were at the tree, my friend? I am ready to give my heart to your wife with pleasure!”

The foolish crocodile asked in amazement: "What's the problem with that now? You're with me anyway and I'll take it from you."

The cunning monkey replied: “We monkeys have a strange habit, my friend. We do not carry our hearts in our chests when we go on trips across the river for fear of them getting wet! Rather, we leave them safely hidden in a secret cavity inside the apple tree, so that they do not get wet and spoil!”

He continued with a fake sigh: “What a pity, if you had told me beforehand, I would have brought him with me.

Now if I die, my heart will die in the tree and your wife will not benefit from it! Take me back to the tree quickly so I can bring it to you from the cavity!”

This very clever lie fooled the stupid and foolish crocodile, and he said happily: “Okay, I will bring you back quickly to get it, as my wife is waiting very eagerly!”

The crocodile turned in the river and started swimming at full speed back towards the tree bank.

As soon as the crocodile approached the bank, and before it was completely anchored, the monkey jumped with a huge leap like lightning from the crocodile’s back to the highest branch of its safe tree!
The monkey sighed with great relief while trembling, then looked at the crocodile below and said angrily: “You stupid and traitorous crocodile! Have you ever seen a creature that can live with its heart outside its chest? I deceived you with my intelligence because you betrayed me with your stupidity! Go away, you will never have my heart and you will never taste my apples from now on. We have lost our friendship forever because of your stupidity and betrayal!”

Thus, the stupid crocodile realized that he lost his loyal friend and his delicious food because he listened to his evil wife’s advice and betrayed his trust and friendship, while the monkey survived thanks to his intelligence and calm in the most difficult moments.
